limits: This is one actual native workflow across a process restart; broader durability proofs remain separate.
SIGTERM uses default process termination exit -15. Initial helper incorrectly required exit0; that failure is retained. No graceful shutdown callback or power-loss guarantee is claimed.
Stale Interactive persisted-state injection has no supported native import route and was not executed; existing model refusal test remains separately attributed.
Only output directory paths were normalized for console comparison; all other console text is identical.
